verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills are instruction folders that Claude loads when it judges them relevant, or that a user invokes with `/skill-name`. That is semantic, model-judged invocation, not user-defined rules that fire actions on events. Event hooks appear only as a Claude Code / Agent SDK feature that plugins can bundle, which is a host-platform capability and earns no credit for the Skills product itself. Community reports that skills often fail to auto-trigger concern that adjacent relevance-loading behavior and do not change this verdict.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
